text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Thump, thump... my heartbeat is racing this much... 
Fufu, ehehehe.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(I still remember seeing Air Groove sing this song, 
and Mejiro Ramonu too. It was so... so dazzling!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Alright, someday I’ll be at the center too! 
Following the example of my seniors, reaching 
everyone’s hearts――
